runtimeFixes.babelRegister: scripts/babel-register.js — @babel/register with same presets as babel-jest for test-runtime parity. Fixes MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash when CLI scripts require() .ts files.
runtimeFixes.detachedSpawn: lib/operational/RecoveryEngine.ts — recovered processes spawned with detached:true + unref() so they survive CLI exit. Previously destroy() killed them, making recovery transient.
runtimeFixes.graceMsCap: lib/operational/RecoveryEngine.ts — recovery graceMs capped at 30s (boot graceMs up to 5min is for cold starts). Without this, hydi:recover hung 300000ms per attempt.
runtimeFixes.eventForwarder: lib/operational/SystemStateModel.ts + OperationalIntelligence.ts — event forwarder callback wires stateModel.logEvent() to memory.record() so events reach durable JSONL storage. Previous wireEventLog() was a stub.

P3-G3_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.evidence: Critical path: database -> protoforge-core -> bridge -> heidi-web; recovery order respects dependencies; infrastructure nodes included

P3-G4_FAILURE_DETECTION.description: Evidence-driven failure detection for 10 failure types
P3-G4_FAILURE_DETECTION.evidence: Detects: process exit, wrong process, endpoint failure, functional failure, dependency failure, database failure, persistence failure, Ollama failure, bridge failure, config/security failure. Verified live across 3 failure classes (see P3-G9).

P3-G5_RECOVERY_ENGINE.evidence: Max 3 attempts; 5s cooldown; idempotent; concurrent recovery prevented; causal (dependencies first); command allowlist from boot.config.json. Runtime fixes: detached spawn (processes survive CLI exit), graceMs cap (30s max for recovery).

P3-G6_RECOVERY_VERIFICATION.description: Postcondition verification — restart success is not assumed
P3-G6_RECOVERY_VERIFICATION.evidence: After each attempt: re-runs full health check, reads new state, records evidence; success only if state is HEALTHY with evidence chain. Verified live: protoforge-core recovery attempt 1 → postcondition check → HEALTHY with port-listening + process-identity + health-endpoint + health-body evidence.

P3-G7_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY.description: Durable event log with correlation IDs
P3-G7_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY.evidence: JSONL file at .hydi-operational/operational-events.jsonl; survives restarts; 5MB rotation; correlation by dependency graph + time window. Runtime-verified: live recovery produced 16 durable events including recovery_started, state_transition (UNKNOWN->RECOVERING->HEALTHY), recovery_step (process_spawned), recovery_completed. Previous gap: wireEventLog() was a stub — events went to in-memory state model only, never to durable storage. Fixed with event forwarder callback.

P3-G8_SECURITY_BOUNDARIES.evidence: 8 capabilities; restart only for boot modules (protoforge-core, heidi-web, heidi-mobile-chat); denied actions counted and logged; no arbitrary shell execution. Commands read from boot.config.json, never from user/AI input.

P3-G9_END_TO_END_AUTONOMY.description: Diagnose + recover CLI commands with live failure injection demonstration
P3-G9_END_TO_END_AUTONOMY.evidence:
Runtime-verified (not just unit-tested). npm run hydi:diagnose produces full snapshot with evidence chains. npm run hydi:recover performs bounded auto-recovery with detached process spawn. Live demonstration across 3 failure classes:
1. Process failure: killed protoforge-core → UNAVAILABLE detected → heidi-web BLOCKED (not UNAVAILABLE) → recovery (1 attempt) → HEALTHY verified
2. Port corruption: Python HTTP server on port 3005 → process-identity FAIL (wrong process: python) → UNAVAILABLE (not false HEALTHY) → recovery killed wrong process + started correct node → HEALTHY verified
3. Dependency failure: killed protoforge-core → heidi-web BLOCKED (causal, not restarted) → auto-recover recovered protoforge-core first → heidi-web auto-unblocked → HEALTHY verified
Previous false green: gate claimed PASS but CLI crashed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND (require() of .ts files). Fixed with @babel/register runtime loader.
